title: Perfect-immersion tensor formula with independent derived localizations
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a proper closed immersion of Noetherian schemes, with independent derived localizations on Z,Y and compatible localization universe on every open of Y. Assume the single complex i_*O_Z[0] is perfect on Y. Let c be the specified right adjoint to the quasi-coherent restriction of Ri*, with a given preservation witness. Let OP be a quasi-coherent object isomorphic to O_Y[0]. For every K in D_QCoh(Y), there is an isomorphism c(K) ≅ L i*(K) tensor^L c(OP) in D(Z), where the pullback is [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes]. The result does not assume i is a diagonal or that a flat proper f or its adjoint is given.

proof.text: Compare both localizations with their standard models. Their Qh comparisons identify homology, single functors, and exact closed-immersion pushforward. On K-flat representatives their tensors compute the same termwise tensor complex, so the tensor and unit comparisons are invertible. The single of i_*O_Z is the standard Ri* of the tensor unit because the closed-immersion module pushforward is exact. Restriction to opens and single-functor comparisons transfer its perfection. Restrict equivalences to quasi-coherent objects and conjugate the specified adjunction; right-derived uniqueness identifies its left adjoint with the standard restricted Ri*.

Apply smooth_proper_diagonal_tensor_formula to the standard perfect proper immersion i and the image of K. Its displayed adjunction mate is invertible, hence gives an isomorphism between Li*K tensor c(unit_Y) and c(K) in the full quasi-coherent category. Apply inclusion and transport back. The transported pullback is the explicitly defined mixed-universe pullback. Map the supplied isomorphism hOP through c, tensor it with Li*K, and invert the isomorphism to get the asserted orientation.
